name: Resistance
summary: Subject gains +1 resistance bonus on saves for 1 minute.

name: Alarm

effects.description: Wards an area (20-ft radius). Triggers mental or audible alarm when Tiny or larger creature enters.

summary: Ward an area to alert you when creatures enter.

name: Endure Elements

effects.target: nonlethal damage from hot or cold environments (-50°F to 140°F)

summary: Subject protected from severe weather (hot and cold) for 24 hours.

name: Hold Portal

effects.description: Holds door/portal shut as if securely locked (adds +5 to DC to force open).

summary: Magically hold a door shut (+5 to break DC).

name: Protection from Chaos

effects.target: mental control (new save with +2 morale bonus) from chaotic creatures

summary: +2 deflection AC, +2 saves vs chaotic; blocks mental control from chaotic sources.

name: Protection from Evil

effects.target: mental control (new save with +2 morale bonus) from evil creatures

summary: +2 deflection AC, +2 saves vs evil; blocks mental control from evil sources.

name: Protection from Good

effects.target: mental control (new save with +2 morale bonus) from good creatures

summary: +2 deflection AC, +2 saves vs good; blocks mental control from good sources.

name: Protection from Law

effects.target: mental control (new save with +2 morale bonus) from lawful creatures

summary: +2 deflection AC, +2 saves vs lawful; blocks mental control from lawful sources.

name: Remove Fear

effects.description: If target is already under a fear effect, gets a new save with +4 morale bonus to suppress the fear.

summary: +4 morale bonus vs fear. Suppresses existing fear effects (new save).

name: Sanctuary

effects.description: Any opponent attempting to directly attack the warded creature must make a Will save. On failure, the opponent cannot attack the creature for the duration. On success, the opponent can act normally. The spell ends if the warded creature attacks.

summary: Opponents must save to attack warded creature. Ends if warded creature attacks.

name: Shield
summary: +4 shield bonus to AC. Immune to magic missile.

name: Shield of Faith
summary: +2 deflection bonus to AC (increases with caster level, max +5).

name: Acid Splash
summary: Ranged touch attack deals 1d3 acid damage.

name: Create Water

effects.description: Create up to 2 gallons of water per caster level.

summary: Create 2 gallons of pure water per caster level.

name: Bless Water

effects.description: Turn a flask of water into holy water. Holy water deals 2d4 damage to undead or evil outsiders on a direct hit.

summary: Create holy water (2d4 damage to undead/evil outsiders).

name: Cure Light Wounds
summary: Heals 1d8 + 1/caster level (max +5) HP.

name: Curse Water

effects.description: Turn a flask of water into unholy water. Unholy water deals 2d4 damage to good outsiders on a direct hit.

summary: Create unholy water (2d4 damage to good outsiders).

name: Grease

effects.effect: Covers ground or object in slippery grease. Creatures in area must save or fall prone. Moving through requires Acrobatics DC 10.

summary: Cover area or object in grease. Creatures must save or fall.

name: Mage Armor
summary: +4 armor bonus to AC (force effect, no max DEX, no ACP, no ASF).

name: Mount
summary: Summon a light horse or pony to serve as a mount.

name: Obscuring Mist

effects.effect: Fog grants concealment (20% miss chance) to creatures within. Creatures 5+ ft away have concealment; beyond that total concealment.

summary: Create a cloud of mist that grants concealment.

name: Summon Monster I

effects.creature: one creature from the 1st-level summon list

summary: Summon one extraplanar creature from the 1st-level list.

name: Summon Nature's Ally I

effects.creature: one animal from the 1st-level nature ally list

summary: Summon one natural creature from the 1st-level list.

name: Unseen Servant

effects.description: Create an invisible, mindless force that performs simple tasks (STR 2, can clean, carry, open doors). Cannot attack or be attacked.

summary: Create an invisible servant to perform simple tasks.

name: Detect Magic
summary: Detect magical auras in a 60-ft cone. Concentration reveals strength and school.

name: Detect Poison

effects.detects: poison in one creature or object

summary: Detect whether a creature, object, or area has been poisoned or is poisonous.

name: Guidance

effects.description: Subject gains +1 competence bonus on a single attack roll, saving throw, or skill check, then the spell ends.

summary: +1 competence bonus on one attack, save, or skill check.

name: Know Direction

effects.description: You instantly know the direction of north from your current position.

summary: Instantly know which direction is north.

name: Read Magic

effects.description: Read scrolls, spellbooks, and magical inscriptions that would otherwise be unintelligible.

summary: Read magical writings (scrolls, spellbooks, inscriptions).

name: Comprehend Languages

effects.description: Understand any spoken or written language (one page per minute for written). Does not grant ability to speak or write.

summary: Understand all spoken and written languages.

name: Deathwatch

effects.detects: living creatures: whether alive, wounded (at or below half HP), at -1 HP or below, dead, or undead

summary: Determine HP status of creatures in range (alive, wounded, dying, dead, undead).

name: Detect Animals or Plants

effects.detects: animals or plants of a specific kind

summary: Detect a specific kind of animal or plant in range.

name: Detect Chaos
summary: Detect chaotic creatures, spells, and objects in a 60-ft cone.

name: Detect Evil
summary: Detect evil creatures, spells, and objects in a 60-ft cone.

name: Detect Good
summary: Detect good creatures, spells, and objects in a 60-ft cone.

name: Detect Law
summary: Detect lawful creatures, spells, and objects in a 60-ft cone.

name: Detect Secret Doors

effects.detects: secret doors, compartments, and hidden caches

summary: Detect secret doors and hidden compartments in a 60-ft cone.

name: Detect Snares and Pits

effects.detects: simple pits, deadfalls, snares, and mechanical traps (natural and primitive)

summary: Detect natural/primitive traps in a 60-ft cone.

name: Detect Undead

effects.detects: undead creatures and their aura strength

summary: Detect undead in a 60-ft cone. Reveals location and aura strength.

name: Identify
materialComponent: wine stirred with an owl feather (100 gp)

effects.description: +10 enhancement bonus on Spellcraft checks to identify properties of magic items. Can attempt one Spellcraft check per round.

summary: +10 Spellcraft to identify magic item properties (1 check/round).

name: Speak with Animals

effects.description: Communicate with animals. Ask questions and receive answers. Animals are not inherently friendly; Diplomacy or similar may be needed.

summary: Communicate verbally with animals for the duration.

name: True Strike

effects.condition: on your next single attack roll (must be before end of next turn)

summary: +20 insight bonus on your next attack roll.

name: Daze
summary: Humanoid of 4 HD or fewer is dazed for 1 round (Will negates).

name: Lullaby
summary: Target has -5 Perception and -2 saves vs sleep effects.

name: Bane
summary: Enemies in 50-ft radius take -1 on attacks and -1 on saves vs fear.

name: Bless
summary: Allies gain +1 morale on attacks and +1 morale on saves vs fear.

name: Charm Animal

effects.condition: charmed (treats you as friendly; +5 to CHA-based checks to interact)

summary: One animal treats you as a trusted friend (Will negates).

name: Charm Person

effects.condition: charmed (treats you as friendly; +5 to CHA-based checks to interact)

summary: One humanoid treats you as a trusted friend (Will negates).

name: Command

effects.description: Give one-word command (approach, drop, fall, flee, halt). Target obeys on its next turn. 6+ HD creatures are immune.

summary: One-word command (approach/drop/fall/flee/halt). Will negates.

name: Doom
summary: One creature becomes shaken (Will negates).

name: Hideous Laughter

effects.condition: prone and unable to act (laughing). Each round may attempt new save to end.

summary: Subject falls prone laughing and cannot take actions (Will negates, new save each round).

name: Hypnotism
summary: Fascinate 2d4 HD of creatures (Will negates).

name: Sleep

effects.condition: sleep (unconscious, can be awakened by damage or standard action)

summary: Put 4 HD of creatures to sleep (Will negates). Lowest HD affected first.

name: Dancing Lights

effects.description: Create up to 4 torch-like lights or 1 vaguely humanoid glowing shape. Lights move as you direct (move action). Each sheds light as a torch.

summary: Create up to 4 hovering lights (torch brightness) that you direct.

name: Flare
summary: Flash of light dazzles one creature for 1 minute (Fort negates).

name: Light

effects.description: Touched object glows like a torch (20-ft radius normal light, 20-ft dim light beyond that).

summary: Object sheds torchlight (20-ft radius) for 10 min/level.

name: Ray of Frost
summary: Ranged touch attack deals 1d3 cold damage.

name: Spark

effects.description: Ignite unattended Fine flammable object (candle, tinder, etc.).

summary: Ignite one unattended Fine flammable object.

name: Burning Hands

effects.effect: All creatures in area take fire damage.

summary: 15-ft cone deals 1d4/level fire damage (max 5d4). Reflex half.

name: Divine Favor
summary: +1 luck bonus to attack and damage per 3 CL (max +3).

name: Floating Disk

effects.description: Create a 3-ft diameter disk of force that floats 3 ft off the ground and follows you. Carries up to 100 lbs/level.

summary: Create a floating disk that carries up to 100 lbs/level.

name: Magic Missile
summary: 1 missile (1d4+1 force) at CL 1, +1 missile per 2 CL (max 5 missiles). Auto-hit.

name: Magic Stone
summary: Up to 3 pebbles gain +1 to attack/damage (2d6+2 vs undead).

name: Magic Weapon
summary: Weapon gains +1 enhancement bonus to attack and damage.

name: Produce Flame

effects.description: Flames appear in your hand, providing light as a torch. Touch attack or throw as ranged touch (close range).

summary: Flames in hand deal 1d6 + 1/level (max +5) fire. Use as touch or ranged touch.

name: Shocking Grasp

effects.description: +3 attack bonus vs opponents wearing metal armor or made of metal.

summary: Touch deals 1d6/level electricity (max 5d6). +3 attack vs metal armor/creatures.

name: Sound Burst
summary: 10-ft spread: 1d8 sonic damage. Fort or stunned 1 round.

name: Ghost Sound

effects.description: Create illusory sounds (up to 4 normal humans per CL). Volume ranges from whisper to loud shouting.

summary: Create illusory sounds. Volume scales with caster level.

name: Color Spray

effects.description: 15-ft cone. Creatures affected based on HD: 2 HD or less = unconscious/blinded/stunned 2d4 rounds then blinded/stunned 1d4 rounds then stunned 1 round; 3-4 HD = blinded/stunned 1d4 rounds then stunned 1 round; 5+ HD = stunned 1 round.

summary: 15-ft cone: creatures stunned/blinded/unconscious based on HD.

name: Disguise Self

effects.description: Change appearance including clothing, armor, weapons, equipment. Can appear up to 1 ft shorter/taller and thin/fat/average.

summary: +10 Disguise. Change appearance (height ±1 ft, build, equipment).

name: Magic Aura

effects.description: Alter an object to radiate a false magic aura (or no aura) to detection spells. One object up to 5 lbs/level.

summary: Make an object radiate a false magical aura (or suppress its aura).

name: Silent Image

effects.description: Create a visual illusion of an object, creature, or force up to 4 10-ft cubes + 1 per CL. No sound, smell, texture, or temperature. Concentration to move/animate.

summary: Create a purely visual illusion (no sound). Concentration to maintain.

name: Vanish

effects.condition: invisible (as invisibility spell, ends on attack)

summary: Subject turns invisible for 1 round/level (max 5). Ends on attack.

name: Ventriloquism

effects.description: Make your voice (or any sound you can make) seem to come from any point within range. You can speak in any language you know.

summary: Project your voice to any location within range.

name: Bleed

effects.description: Cause a dying creature (at negative HP) to resume losing 1 HP per round. Only works on living creatures currently at negative HP and stable.

summary: Cause a stable dying creature to resume losing HP.

name: Disrupt Undead
summary: Ranged touch deals 1d6 damage to one undead.

name: Stabilize

effects.description: Target dying creature (at negative HP) becomes stable.

summary: Stabilize a dying creature (does not restore HP).

name: Touch of Fatigue
summary: Touch fatigues target (Fort negates). No effect on already fatigued creatures.

name: Cause Fear

effects.condition: frightened (1d4 rounds, or shaken 1 round on save)

summary: One creature of 5 HD or less becomes frightened (Will: shaken 1 round).

name: Chill Touch
savingThrow: Fortitude partial or Will negates (see text)

effects.description: One touch per level. Each touch deals 1d6 negative energy and 1 STR damage (Fort negates STR damage). Against undead: no damage but target flees for 1d4+CL rounds (Will negates).

summary: Touch deals 1d6 + 1 STR damage per touch (1 touch/level).

name: Inflict Light Wounds

effects.description: Deals 1d8 + 1/level (max +5) negative energy damage. Heals undead for same amount.

summary: Touch deals 1d8 + 1/level (max +5) negative energy. Heals undead.

name: Ray of Enfeeblement

effects.description: Ranged touch attack imposes 1d6+1 per 2 CL (max 1d6+5) STR penalty. Fort halves. Cannot reduce below 1.

summary: Ray imposes 1d6+1 per 2 CL (max +5) STR penalty. Fort halves.

name: Ray of Sickening
summary: Ray sickens target for 1 round/level. Fort: sickened 1 round only.

name: Mage Hand

effects.description: Telekinetically move one non-magical object up to 5 lbs. Move 15 ft per round. Cannot attack, activate magic items, or carry creatures.

summary: Move one object up to 5 lbs at a distance (15 ft/round).

name: Mending

effects.description: Repair one break or tear in an object (up to 1 lb). Does not restore magical properties.

summary: Repair one break or tear in an object up to 1 lb.

name: Message

effects.description: Whisper a message that only designated creatures (1 per CL) can hear. They can whisper back.

summary: Whisper conversations at distance with designated creatures.

name: Open/Close

effects.description: Open or close a door, chest, box, window, bag, pouch, bottle, barrel, or similar container (up to 30 lbs or with a simple latch). Cannot open locked items.

summary: Remotely open or close one small unlocked object.

name: Purify Food and Drink

effects.description: Purify 1 cu. ft./level of food and water, rendering it free of poison, disease, and rot.

summary: Make contaminated food and water pure and suitable for consumption.

name: Virtue
summary: Subject gains 1 temporary hit point for 1 minute.

name: Animate Rope

effects.description: Animate a rope (up to 50 ft + 5 ft/level) to coil, knot, loop, or entangle. Entangle: CMB = 10 + CL.

summary: Animate a rope to coil, knot, or entangle (CMB = 10 + CL).

name: Enlarge Person

effects.description: Humanoid target grows one size category. +2 size STR, -2 size DEX, -1 attack/AC (size), +1 CMB/CMD.

summary: Grow one size. +2 STR, -2 DEX, -1 attack/AC, +1 CMB/CMD.

name: Entangle

effects.effect: Plants entangle creatures in area. Entangled creatures are -2 attack, -4 DEX. Reflex to avoid being stuck (immobile). DC 20 STR or Escape Artist to break free each round.

summary: 40-ft radius: plants entangle. -2 attack, -4 DEX. Reflex or stuck.

name: Erase

effects.description: Erase nonmagical writing from a surface (2 pages). Magical writing: CL check DC 15.

summary: Erase mundane or magical writing from a surface.

name: Expeditious Retreat

effects.description: Base land speed increases by 30 ft (enhancement bonus). Does not affect other movement types.

summary: +30 ft enhancement bonus to base land speed.

name: Feather Fall

effects.description: Up to 1 creature/level falls slowly (60 ft per round). Take no falling damage on landing.

summary: Up to 1 creature/level falls slowly, taking no falling damage.

name: Goodberry

effects.description: Transmute 2d4 fresh berries so each cures 1 HP (max 8 HP total). Also provides nourishment as a full meal.

summary: 2d4 berries each heal 1 HP and nourish as a full meal.

name: Jump

effects.description: +10 enhancement to Acrobatics for jumping (+20 at CL 5, +30 at CL 9).

summary: +10/+20/+30 enhancement bonus to Acrobatics for jumping.

name: Longstrider

effects.description: Base speed increases by 10 ft (enhancement bonus).

summary: +10 ft enhancement bonus to base speed.

name: Magic Fang
summary: One natural weapon gains +1 enhancement to attack and damage.

name: Reduce Person

effects.description: Humanoid target shrinks one size category. -2 size STR, +2 size DEX, +1 attack/AC (size), -1 CMB/CMD.

summary: Shrink one size. -2 STR, +2 DEX, +1 attack/AC, -1 CMB/CMD.

name: Shillelagh

effects.description: A non-magical club or quarterstaff you hold is enhanced: +1 enhancement to attack/damage and damage dice increase by two steps (club to 1d10, quarterstaff to 2d6).

summary: Club/quarterstaff gains +1 and damage dice increase two steps.

name: Arcane Mark

effects.description: Inscribes a personal rune or mark (up to 6 characters) on an object or creature (visible or invisible). Detectable by detect magic. An arcane mark on a living creature fades after 1 month.

summary: Inscribe a personal rune on an object or creature.

name: Prestidigitation

effects.description: Minor magical tricks: lift 1 lb, color/clean/soil items in 1 cu ft, chill/warm/flavor 1 lb of material, create small trinkets or illusions (too crude to fool anyone). Once per round. Can maintain up to 3 effects.

summary: Perform minor magical tricks (clean, color, warm, create trinkets, etc.).
